long_biography.plain_text:
At Delta Air Lines, Glen Hauenstein argued that greater choice should not overwhelm travellers. He compared the task to navigating the enormous menus of the New Jersey diners he remembered from his youth. His aim was to present customers with a manageable selection of fares suited to their needs and preferences.

Hauenstein also mentored communications executive Andrew McCaskill, encouraging him to accept an assignment in Shanghai for Nielsen. At his alma mater, Stetson University, he serves as a trustee. He helped shape a business-ethics case there, asking students to weigh sustainable fuel's environmental benefits against its higher cost.
